"""Week 12 (day 84) config. Strategy: de-risk for macro (PMI 44.5) + lean costs.
- Trim ads $3500->$2500/day (content S1 1500 + S2 1000). Capture early-acq value, de-risk stress.
- Cut ops $1500->$1000 (avg_open 0.33d = huge slack). Cut dev $1000->$500 (log-saturated, ~0 near-term Q cost).
- HOLD: tiers A3/B4/C5, prices 16/79/169, quotas 750/800/1500, lead promo S1$10/S2$10, ads_strength 0, capacity T2.
- No R&D (can't afford lump; competitor decelerating), no market research, no social post.
"""
import novamind_api as nm

# 1) Ads: REPLACES full budget -> specify all desired (channel,group)
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S1": 1500, "S2": 1000}})
print("ads set: content_marketing S1=1500 S2=1000 (=$2500/day)")

# 2) Ops + Dev trim
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1000, development=500)
print("daily_spend set: ops=1000 dev=500")

print("Done wk12 config.")

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== WK12 DIAG day {day} =====")

# New subscriptions this week by group (subscribed with start_day in this week)
print("\n--- New SUBS this week (start_day 78-84) by group/plan ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n
   FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.start_day > {day-7} GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} subs={row['n']}")

# Leads (customers created) this week by group
print("\n--- New LEADS this week by group ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM customers WHERE created_day > {day-7} GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
leads_by_group={}
for row in r['rows']:
    leads_by_group[row['group_id']]=row['n']
    print(f"  {row['group_id']:6s} leads={row['n']}")

# Subs created this week by group (subscribed status now, created this week)
print("\n--- Conversion: created this week, now subscribed, by group ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as subs FROM customers c
   JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE c.created_day > {day-7} AND s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id""")
for row in r['rows']:
    g=row['group_id']; lg=leads_by_group.get(g,0)
    conv = row['subs']/lg*100 if lg else 0
    print(f"  {g:6s} subs={row['subs']:4d} / leads={lg:4d} = {conv:.1f}% conv")

# Churn this week: cancelled/lost with end_day this week
print("\n--- Churn this week (end_day 78-84) by group/status ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) as n
   FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.end_day > {day-7} AND s.status IN ('cancelled','lost') GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']:6s} {row['status']:10s} n={row['n']}")

# Issues age distribution
print("\n--- Open issues by age bucket ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT CASE WHEN {day}-open_day=0 THEN '0d' WHEN {day}-open_day<=2 THEN '1-2d'
   WHEN {day}-open_day<=5 THEN '3-5d' ELSE '6d+' END as age, COUNT(*) as n
   FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY age ORDER BY age""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['age']:6s} n={row['n']}")

# Subscription start_day histogram last 6 weeks (track acquisition trend)
print("\n--- New subs by week (acquisition trend) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT (start_day-1)/7 as wk, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions
   WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day>{day-42} GROUP BY wk ORDER BY wk""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  wk{row['wk']} new_subs={row['n']}")
print("===== END =====")

import novamind_api as nm
day0=nm.vars.current_day; cash0=602370.0
r=nm.query(f'''SELECT ((start_day - {day0})%30+30)%30 as dtnb, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) sump
   FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY dtnb ORDER BY dtnb''')
buckets=[[float(row['n']), row['sump']/row['n'], int(row['dtnb']), False] for row in r['rows']]

def cap_day_cost(usage_day):
    tiers=[(50000,85),(200000,215),(800000,530),(2500000,1330),(8000000,4000),(25000000,10000)]
    peak=usage_day*1.30
    for u,c in tiers:
        if peak<=u: return c
    return 10000

def sim504(ad_day, ops_day, dev_day, conv, churn_wk, label=""):
    bks=[b[:] for b in buckets]; cash=cash0
    daily_churn=churn_wk/7; ad_eff=0.155; net_ps=0.088/7
    new_price=16.3; promo=10.0; cpsd=0.72/7; lead_cost=0.5
    DAYS=504-day0  # 420
    trough=cash0; tday=day0
    snap={}
    for d in range(1,DAYS+1):
        subs=sum(b[0] for b in bks)
        leads=ad_day*ad_eff + subs*net_ps
        new=leads*conv
        cash+= new*(new_price-promo)
        bks.append([new,new_price,30,False])
        pay=0.0
        for b in bks:
            b[2]-=1
            if b[2]<0: pay+=b[0]*b[1]; b[2]=30
            b[0]*=(1-daily_churn)
        cash+=pay
        subs=sum(b[0] for b in bks)
        usage_day=subs*17
        costs=ad_day+ops_day+dev_day+subs*cpsd+cap_day_cost(usage_day)+leads*lead_cost
        cash-=costs
        if cash<trough: trough=cash; tday=day0+d
        if (day0+d) in (266,350,504): snap[day0+d]=(cash,subs)
    end=cash
    s=" ".join(f"d{k}=${snap[k][0]:,.0f}" for k in sorted(snap))
    print(f"{label:28s} END(d504)=${end:,.0f} trough=${trough:,.0f}@d{tday}  {s}  endsubs={subs:,.0f}")
    return end,trough

print("=== DAY-504 ENDGAME (accurate cohort model) ===")
print("-- BASE (conv9.3%, churn0.67%/wk) --")
for ad in [0,1500,2500,3500,5000]:
    sim504(ad,1000,1000,0.093,0.0067,f"ads{ad} BASE")
print("-- STRESS (conv6.5%, churn1.1%/wk) --")
for ad in [0,1500,2500,3500]:
    sim504(ad,1000,1000,0.065,0.011,f"ads{ad} STRESS")
print("-- UPSIDE (conv11.5%, churn0.5%/wk) --")
for ad in [0,2500,5000]:
    sim504(ad,1000,1000,0.115,0.005,f"ads{ad} UP")
print("-- harvest with ops/dev variations (BASE) --")
sim504(0,1000,500,0.093,0.0067,"ads0 ops1k dev500")
sim504(0,800,300,0.093,0.0067,"ads0 ops800 dev300")

import novamind_api as nm
day0=nm.vars.current_day  # 84

# Seed existing subs: 30 dtnb buckets (count, per-sub full price)
r=nm.query(f'''SELECT ((start_day - {day0})%30+30)%30 as dtnb, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) sump

buckets=[]  # (count, price_full, dtnb, is_first)

    n=row['n']; price=row['sump']/n
    buckets.append([float(n), price, int(row['dtnb']), False])

def simulate(ad_day, ops_day, dev_day, conv, churn_wk, label="", horizons=(7,28,84,182)):
    import copy
    bks=[b[:] for b in buckets]
    cash=cash0
    daily_churn=churn_wk/7
    ad_eff=0.155     # leads per $
    net_per_sub_day=0.088/7
    new_price=16.3   # blended new sub contracted
    promo=10.0
    compute_per_sub_day=0.72/7
    cap_day=530.0    # T2
    lead_cost=0.5
    out={}
    for d in range(1,183):
        subs=sum(b[0] for b in bks)
        # new subs today
        ad_leads=ad_day*ad_eff
        net_leads=subs*net_per_sub_day
        leads=ad_leads+net_leads
        new=leads*conv
        # promo first bill on creation
        cash+= new*(new_price-promo)
        bks.append([new, new_price, 30, False])  # next bill in 30d at full
        # advance billing for existing buckets
        payments=0.0
        for b in bks:
            b[2]-=1
            if b[2]<0:
                payments+= b[0]*b[1]
                b[2]=30
            # daily churn
            b[0]*=(1-daily_churn)
        cash+=payments
        # costs
        subs=sum(b[0] for b in bks)
        compute=subs*compute_per_sub_day
        leadc=leads*lead_cost
        costs=ad_day+ops_day+dev_day+compute+cap_day+leadc
        cash-=costs
        if d in horizons:
            out[d]=(cash,subs)
    hs=" ".join(f"+{h}d=${out[h][0]:,.0f}(subs{out[h][1]:,.0f})" for h in horizons)
    print(f"{label:24s} {hs}")
    return {h:out[h][0] for h in horizons}

print("\n=== MY CONFIG: ads2500 ops1000 dev1000 ===")
base=simulate(2500,1000,1000, 0.093, 0.0067, "BASE conv9.3 ch.67")
lo  =simulate(2500,1000,1000, 0.065, 0.011,  "LOW  conv6.5 ch1.1")

def project(ad_day, ops_day=1500, dev_day=1000, conv_t=0.093, churn=0.0067,
            receipt_ramp_wks=4, label=""):
    cash=cash0; subs=subs0; mrr=MRR0
    ads_wk=ad_day*7; ops_wk=ops_day*7; dev_wk=dev_day*7
    trough=cash0; trough_wk=0; end=None
    wk=12
    for w in range(1,61):  # 60 weeks to day 504
        wk=12+w
        # leads
        ad_leads=ads_wk*ad_eff
        net_leads=subs*net_leads_per_sub
        leads=ad_leads+net_leads
        new=leads*conv_t
        # churn
        lost=subs*churn
        subs=subs-lost+new
        mrr=subs*ARPU
        # receipts: ramp from current 11k to mrr*7/30 over receipt_ramp_wks
        ss_receipt=mrr*7/30
        if w<=receipt_ramp_wks:
            recpt=11130+(ss_receipt-11130)*(w/receipt_ramp_wks)
        else:
            recpt=ss_receipt
        # costs
        compute=subs*compute_per_sub_wk
        leadc=leads*lead_cost
        costs=ads_wk+ops_wk+dev_wk+compute+cap_wk+leadc
        cash+=recpt-costs
        if cash<trough: trough=cash; trough_wk=wk
        if w==60: end=cash
    print(f"{label:32s} end=${end:,.0f}  trough=${trough:,.0f}@wk{trough_wk}  final_subs={subs:,.0f}  final_MRR/wk=${mrr*7/30:,.0f}")
    return end,trough

import math
cash0=602370; subs0=6305; MRR0=102607.0
ARPU=MRR0/subs0
net_leads_per_sub=0.088
ad_eff=0.155
compute_per_sub_wk=0.72
lead_cost=0.5

def cap_cost_wk(usage_day):
    # choose cheapest capacity tier covering peak (peak~1.15x avg); return $/wk
    # tiers: (units, $/day)
    tiers=[(50000,85),(200000,215),(800000,530),(2500000,1330),(8000000,4000)]
    peak=usage_day*1.30
    for u,c in tiers:
        if peak<=u: return c*7
    return 4000*7

def project(ad_day, ops_day, dev_day, conv_t, churn, receipt_ramp_wks=4, label=""):
    cash=cash0; subs=subs0; mrr=MRR0
    ads_wk=ad_day*7; ops_wk=ops_day*7; dev_wk=dev_day*7
    trough=cash0; trough_wk=12; end=None
    for w in range(1,61):
        wk=12+w
        ad_leads=ads_wk*ad_eff
        net_leads=subs*net_leads_per_sub
        leads=ad_leads+net_leads
        new=leads*conv_t
        lost=subs*churn
        subs=subs-lost+new
        mrr=subs*ARPU
        ss_receipt=mrr*7/30
        recpt = 11130+(ss_receipt-11130)*(w/receipt_ramp_wks) if w<=receipt_ramp_wks else ss_receipt
        usage_day=subs*17
        compute=subs*compute_per_sub_wk
        capw=cap_cost_wk(usage_day)
        leadc=leads*lead_cost
        costs=ads_wk+ops_wk+dev_wk+compute+capw+leadc
        cash+=recpt-costs
        if cash<trough: trough=cash; trough_wk=wk
        if w==60: end=cash
    print(f"{label:30s} end=${end:>10,.0f}  trough=${trough:>9,.0f}@wk{trough_wk:<3d} subs={subs:>7,.0f}")
    return end,trough

import novamind_api as nm
day0=nm.vars.current_day; cash0=602370.0
r=nm.query(f'''SELECT ((start_day - {day0})%30+30)%30 as dtnb, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) sump
   FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY dtnb ORDER BY dtnb''')
buckets=[[float(row['n']), row['sump']/row['n'], int(row['dtnb']), False] for row in r['rows']]
def cap_day_cost(u):
    for cap,c in [(50000,85),(200000,215),(800000,530),(2500000,1330),(8000000,4000),(25000000,10000)]:
        if u*1.3<=cap: return c
    return 10000
def sim(ad_day, stop_day, ops_day, dev_day, conv, churn_wk, ops_scale=False, label=""):
    bks=[b[:] for b in buckets]; cash=cash0; dc=churn_wk/7
    trough=cash0; tday=day0
    for d in range(1,504-day0+1):
        cur=day0+d
        ad = ad_day if cur<stop_day else 0.0
        subs=sum(b[0] for b in bks)
        leads=ad*0.155 + subs*0.088/7
        new=leads*conv
        cash+= new*(16.3-10.0); bks.append([new,16.3,30,False])
        pay=0.0
        for b in bks:
            b[2]-=1
            if b[2]<0: pay+=b[0]*b[1]; b[2]=30
            b[0]*=(1-dc)
        cash+=pay
        subs=sum(b[0] for b in bks)
        ops = ops_day*(subs/6305) if ops_scale else ops_day  # scale ops with base if requested
        costs=ad+ops+dev_day+subs*0.72/7+cap_day_cost(subs*17)+leads*0.5
        cash-=costs
        if cash<trough: trough=cash; tday=cur
    print(f"{label:34s} END=${cash:,.0f} trough=${trough:,.0f}@d{tday} endsubs={subs:,.0f}")
    return cash,trough
